# Version 4.150.8 (Unreleased)
> **Safer rasterization and texture sampling**

## Highlights

Upcoming servicing fixes improve raster-pipeline failure handling, conic regions and texture sampling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Raster and region safety** — Prevents a partially constructed runtime-shader raster pipeline from executing after stage construction fails. Corrects conic-region buffer sizing and rejects edge-count overflow to prevent out-of-bounds writes. ([#5633](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5633), [#5543](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5543))
- **Texture uploads and subset boundaries** — Disables unsupported RGBA uploads to BGRA textures interpreted as RGBx on GLES. Preserves nearest-filtered texture subset boundaries under magnification and fractional mappings without dropping the integer-mapping fast path. ([#5543](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5543))
